article.title: Assistance to States by deployment of armed forces or other forces of the Union
article.content:
257AAssistance to States by deployment of armed forces or other forces of the Union

Article 257A · Part XI · General
Omitted by the Constitution (Forty-fourth Amendment) Act, 1978, s. 33 (w.e.f. 20-6-1979).

1 Ins. by the Constitution (Forty-second Amendment) Act, 1976, s. 43 (w.e.f. 3-1-1977).
